heading: Before you create this budget

items.text: You are creating a personal budget space and you become its sole Primary Owner.
A Primary Owner fully administers this budget space. Creating it gives no payment, financial, legal, or bank-account authority, and it moves no money.
Nobody else can see this budget space. Sharing it with another person is a separate invitation that the other person accepts or declines; nothing here shares anything.
You can transfer primary ownership or archive this budget space later. Each is a separate action you take, and nothing else removes you as Primary Owner.
Confirming is your agreement to the items above, and it makes you Primary Owner immediately. Nothing is chosen for you.

acknowledgement: I have read the items above and I agree to become Primary Owner of this budget space.
